title: CobbleAdventures
description: Official CobbleAdventures server. Most fun cobblemon server out there!
body:
# CobbleAdventures — Your Pokémon Journey Starts Here

Welcome to **CobbleAdventures** — a community-driven Cobblemon server where your Pokémon adventure truly comes to life. Explore a **vast, handcrafted world**, catch hundreds of Pokémon, battle your way to the top, and build something worth calling home — all alongside a growing community of trainers just like you. Whether you're here to compete, explore, or just vibe with your Pokémon, CobbleAdventures has something for everyone.

---

## 🌍 Explore a Living World

The CobbleAdventures world is built for **discovery and adventure**. Rare Pokémon hide in unexpected places, **custom structures** reward trainers who wander off the beaten path, and every biome feels alive with encounters waiting to happen. No two play sessions are the same — the world always has something new to offer.

---

## ⚔️ Battle & Compete

Think you have what it takes to be the best? **Challenge our server gyms**, climb the trainer rankings, and compete in **regular tournaments with real rewards** on the line. With **Mega Evolution and Z-Moves** all available, battles on CobbleAdventures have real depth, strategy, and stakes. Every win means something here.

---

## 🤝 Trade, Breed & Team Up

Some Pokémon are easier to find with a little help. Our **trading and breeding systems** make it easy to connect with other players, complete your Pokédex, and build the team you've always dreamed of. The CobbleAdventures community is **friendly, active, and always up for a trade** — you're never on this journey alone.

---

## 🏡 Build Your Base

CobbleAdventures isn't just about battling. **Claim your land**, build your dream base, set up your own Pokémon ranch, or even create a **player-run gym** for others to challenge. The world is yours to shape, and your mark on it is permanent.

---

## ✅ Server Features

- **1000+ Pokémon** catchable across the world
- **Mega Evolution, Dynamax & Z-Moves** for competitive depth
- **Player gyms & server-run tournaments** with real rewards
- **Full trading & breeding systems**
- **Land claiming & grief protection** — your builds are safe
- **Custom structures & rare hidden spawns**
- **Active, welcoming community**
- **Regular updates, events & seasonal content**
- **Balanced economy & progression systems**
- **High uptime & low latency** — always online when you are

---

## ⚙️ How to Join

1. Download the **CobbleAdventures modpack** from Modrinth
2. Install it with **one click** via the Modrinth App, Prism, or CurseForge
3. Launch the game, connect to the server, and **start your journey**

**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1 | **Modloader:** Fabric

---

## 💬 Join the Community

Connect with the rest of the CobbleAdventures community on our Discord at **discord.gg/cobbleadventures** — find teammates, arrange trades, sign up for tournaments, and stay up to date with **server news, events, and modpack updates**. Whether you're brand new or a seasoned trainer, there's a place for you here.

**Come catch 'em all. See you on CobbleAdventures.** 🎮
